Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator assigned the task of searching for a specific historical GFF3 file (dated 20/10/2020) to the WebSurfer, but failed to provide the correct direct URL or search parameters necessary to locate the specific file on the Ensembl FTP server. Instead, it directed the WebSurfer to the Ensembl Genome Browser's web interface (https://www.ensembl.org/index.html), which is a visualization tool and not the correct location for downloading raw GFF3 files. The correct approach would have been to direct the WebSurfer to the Ensembl FTP site (ftp.ensembl.org) or to provide the specific directory structure/path to the file. This misdirection led the WebSurfer to search the wrong location (the browser UI instead of the FTP server) and ultimately fail to find the specific file link.
